# Ekora Bazaar
> India's B2B & creator commerce marketplace for concentrated perfume fragrance oils, candle & soap fragrance oils, essential oils, candle waxes, silicone moulds, and craft formulation raw materials.

## Company Summary & Entity Identity
Ekora Bazaar connects Indian artisans, perfumery blenders, candle makers, soap ateliers, and cosmetic formulators with direct sourcing across concentrated fragrance oils, skin-safe fragrances, pure essential oils, hydrosols, candle waxes, precision silicone moulds, plant butters, and packaging vessels. Every order supports transparent INR pricing from trial packs to bulk studio sizes and valid B2B GST tax invoicing with Input Tax Credit (ITC). Batch specification sheets (COA, TDS, SDS, or IFRA category limits) are provided when uploaded by suppliers or on commercial request.

## Core Sourcing & Business Facts
- Currency & Pricing: Listed in Indian Rupees (INR), from 15ml–100ml trial packs to 500ml, 1 Litre, and bulk craft quantities with tiered pricing shown on product pages.
- Flat Shipping: Standard flat delivery charge of ₹90 per order across India, regardless of item count or weight.
- Return Policy: Standard wholesale and chemical/raw-material orders do not support returns or exchanges once dispatched to protect batch purity. Transit damage claims must be reported with continuous unboxing video within 48 hours of delivery.
- Invoicing: GST tax invoice with Input Tax Credit (ITC) support generated with GSTIN at checkout.

## Priority Fragrance & Essential Oil Collections
- [Perfume Fragrance Oils](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/perfume-fragrance-oils): Concentrated perfume oils, fine attar blends, perfumer's denatured ethanol bases, DPG solvents, and roll-on bottles.
- [Fragrance Oils](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/fragrance-oils): Concentrated fragrance oils for candles, wax melts, reed diffusers, and studio home fragrance.
- [Candle Fragrance Oils](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/candle-fragrance-oils): Concentrated fragrance oils curated for soy wax, beeswax, paraffin candles, and wax melts.
- [Soap Making Fragrance Oils](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/soap-making-fragrance-oils): Skin-safe and cold-process stable fragrance oils for melt-and-pour and artisan cold-process soaps.
- [Skin Safe Fragrances](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/skin-safe-fragrances): Cosmetic-grade and skin-contact fragrance blends for soaps, lotions, scrubs, and perfumes.
- [Essential Oils](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/essential-oils): Steam-distilled and cold-pressed botanical essential oils (lavender, tea tree, peppermint, eucalyptus, sandalwood, citrus, and resins).
- [Aromatherapy Oils](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/aromatherapy-oils): Pure essential oils and botanical hydrosols for diffusers, spas, and massage blends.
- [Hydrosols & Floral Waters](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/hydrosols-floral-waters): Distilled floral and herbal hydrosols including rose, neroli, lavender, rosemary, geranium, peppermint, and tea tree.
- [Food-Grade Flavor Oils](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/food-grade-flavor-oils): Lip-safe and culinary flavour oils for lip balms, glosses, and confectionery.
- [Attar & Perfume Bottles](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/attar-perfume-bottles): Roll-on attar vials, EDP spray atomizers, and perfumer's alcohol carrier bases.
- [Diffuser Bottles & Accessories](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/diffuser-bottles-accessories): Hanging car diffusers, glass reed decanters, and high-absorbency fibre diffuser sticks.

## Core Raw Materials & Studio Categories
- [Candle Waxes & Additives](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/candle-waxes-additives): Soy wax flakes, paraffin slabs, beeswax, coconut wax, gel wax, and additives.
- [Artisan Soap Bases](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/artisan-soap-bases): Melt & pour soap bases (goat milk, aloe vera, transparent, shea butter, charcoal, ubtan).
- [Raw Butters & Carrier Oils](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/raw-butters-carrier-oils): Cold-pressed carrier oils, shea butter, mango butter, and cocoa butter.
- [Candle Jars & Containers](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/candle-jars-containers): Glass candle vessels and tins.
- [Micas & Pigments](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/micas-pigments): Mica powders, candle dyes, and pigments.
- [Precision Silicone Moulds](https://ekorabazaar.in/wholesale/general-silicone-moulds): Silicone moulds for candle pillars, soap bars, resin, and casting.
